capabilities: Render slack code blocks as Slack mrkdwn, including threads, replies and reactions
Display custom emoji from registered Slack workspaces in preview and live editing
Copy a note or selection as Slack text in slack/texty, HTML and plain mrkdwn formats
Import a Slack thread from a message link as a slack block or Markdown callout
Refresh an imported thread block to pick up new replies and reactions
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.11.4 or later; the Slack token is kept in Obsidian's secret storage and emoji images are cached in the plugin folder with a default 50 MB limit. Formatted clipboard copy may fall back to plain mrkdwn on some platforms such as mobile. README documents its network use and states there is no telemetry.
problem: Obsidian has no way to preview Slack mrkdwn with a workspace's custom emoji or to convert notes into formatting that pastes correctly into Slack.

relations.evidence: Register one or more Slack workspaces; :party_parrot: shows that workspace's image in code blocks
The format is Slack's internal one, found via slackfmt

summary: Slack mrkdwn previewer that renders slack code blocks with workspace custom emoji, copies notes as Slack-formatted text, and imports Slack threads.
